brief:
Foreign ministers from Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan issued a joint statement naming Israeli occupation as the primary source of instability across the Middle East, according to Ma'an Wire. The statement reflects alignment among the four countries on a core regional grievance as tensions persist in the occupied Palestinian territories and broader Middle East.

The four nations—three Arab states and one South Asian country—released the statement as part of coordinated diplomatic messaging on the conflict.
title: Four nations blame Israeli occupation for regional instability
